Implemented the complete `iges` CLI tool in `output/` as a C++20, standard-library-only CMake project (`output/CMakeLists.txt:1`).

- Build: `cd output && cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
- Binary: `output/build/iges` implements `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip` per the contract (`output/src/main.cpp:203`)
- IGES fixed-format parsing/writing (80 cols, sections, DE/PD handling, delimiter rules including Global form 4) is in `output/src/iges.cpp:459`, `output/src/iges.cpp:2344`, `output/src/iges.cpp:4192`
- `eval` supports the required curve/surface entity types and applies transformation matrices as specified (`output/src/eval.cpp:951`)
- Canonical JSON parsing/stringifying is implemented in `output/src/json.h:1` and `output/src/json.cpp:1`
